name: proofstory-intent-artifact-scope-classify
title: Scope classifier misses ProofStory intent artifacts, forcing manual scope acknowledgements
description: The scope gate's lifecycle-artifact classifier (classifyLifecycleArtifact in packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts) recognizes checklist.json, decision.json, review.json, scope-check.json, scope-contract.json, understanding.json and other command-generated story metadata via LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES, but NOT the ProofStory high-assurance intent artifacts written by store.ts into the story directory: original-intent-snapshot.json (original_intent_snapshot_set), intent-collision.json (intent_collision_set), red-evidence.json (red_evidence_create), proofstory.json (proofstory_contract_set), plus the sibling command-generated files milestone-ledger.json (milestone ledger set) and spike.json (spike evidence). Under mode=enforce these classify rule=out_of_scope and block the DEV->REVIEW scope gate, forcing owners to hand-add story-metadata paths into their own scope contract. This recurs for every high-assurance story.
